## Lineage
Princes of Halshany: **Ivan Olshansky** (Jonas Alšėniškis), one of Vytautas's chief captains and (to verify) governor of Kyiv after Skirgaila, and his son Andrei. **Julijona Alšėniškė** married Vytautas on 13 Nov 1418; **Sophia (Sonka) of Halshany** (c. 1405–1461) married Jogaila on 7 Feb 1422 and bore Władysław III and Casimir IV. The record has Julijona as Sophia's aunt (genealogy to verify). Characters: [Julijona](../characters/julijona.qmd). [Record]

## Feuds & alliances
Allies of [Vytautas](../characters/vytautas.qmd) and then of the [Jogailaičiai](jogailaiciai.qmd) through two marriages; servants of the Grand Duchy ([GDL](../factions/gdl.qmd)). Orthodox-born lords who still hold princely rank. The house that married both cousins.

## Fate across the books
- **IV:** Julijona enters in ch. 10 (1418), clever enough to see Vytautas listening to something under the floor; Vytautas picks Sophia for Jogaila (ch. 13, Melno year) and her sons become the heirs (ch. 14).
- **V:** Casimir, Sophia's son, is raised Grand Duke by the council in 1440, and the family's blood sits on two thrones.
